title: Credential incident supplier replacement service interfaces
applicability: PSP product accounts; Replacement supplier transfers made while an original network instruction may remain live.
content:
Replacement supplier transfers made while an original network instruction may remain live.

These interfaces belong only to this business service. They do not authorize operations in another Payment service or portal.
Read the related business rules for eligibility, fees, timing and state meaning. Unlocking an exact interface returns its executable JSON Schema.
Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. An identifier supplied only by an author reference is not a valid input source.

## `send_incident_supplier_replacement`

Submit an independent replacement for the original supplier invoice using an active credential. regular and priority have public fees and settlement delays. An in-flight original is not cancelled by this new transfer and can still settle, creating duplicate supplier delivery. The principal is reserved until its actual delivery event.

### Inputs

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `incident_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `credential_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `service` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

The executable schema returned by the unlock call is authoritative for types, required fields and enumerated values. This manual defines business meaning and scope; it does not select a task-specific option or execution order.
